problems: 22 pages opened, none failed. The Afghan Interim Government URL served the 2001 Interim Administration article (used for 22 Dec 2001 only), so afghanistan used 6 pages against a budget of 5; kyrgyzstan used 3 against 1-2 (the Kyrgyz-Tajik border page was shared with Tajikistan).

Cliopatria 'Mujahideen' (Q42759) is two unrelated things: the Afghan resistance (1987-1992, then the state itself) and an outline in Syria for 2014-2024 that no page identifies. Shapes 1992, 2014 and 2024 are marked wrong; nothing was split off into a new slug.

Start years follow the real founding dates (Kyrgyzstan 31 Aug 1991, Tajikistan 9 Sep 1991, Kazakhstan 16 Dec 1991, Afghanistan 30 Apr 1978) instead of Cliopatria's first shape year, with new one-year keyframes; 1991 therefore overlaps the USSR's last year and 1978 overlaps republic-of-afghanistan's last year. The orchestrator should confirm the overlap convention.

Cliopatria's Afghanistan row has no shape for 1987-1995 (the 'Mujahideen' row stands in) and its Afghanistan (1996-2005) and Taliban (1996-2005) rows run four years past the Taliban's fall in December 2001; afghanistan_2002 restores the whole country, and the taliban dossier should cut its row at 2001.
Q889 is shared by emirate-of-afghanistan, kingdom-of-afghanistan, republic-of-afghanistan and afghanistan: kept as separate dossiers (already so written by other parts).
Kazakhstan, Mongolia: no wars; their Cliopatria shapes change only by Aral Sea shoreline cells or vertex noise, so the real treaties are low-confidence events below one grid cell.
